findings.what: Shell is hard to find and see. I took three of my own sandbox screenshots (reviews/s97_a/b/c.png: default view, then fixed cameras at Shell's saved positions in both state files) and Shell was in none of them; it wanders, and its positions in the two state files differ. The post picture also shows it very small at the frame edge. The trust arc was too slow in the human's game (33 meetings, all still scared) and was then tuned by guesswork (0.1 per meeting, doubled beside Lumi).

summary: A generated creature, Shell, washes ashore and gains trust per friend across days; the traced post still shows its real body and the sandbox runs at 3 ms median frame time. In my own sandbox screenshots I could not locate Shell on the island, so I could not judge its live look.
surprise_why: A permanent newcomer whose per-friend trust persists across days changes who lives on the island, rather than being another scripted gathering.
